headline: Moonshot's giant Kimi K3 nudges capability higher
body: A light day. Beijing's Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model it calls the largest open model and a rival to top US systems. That lifted Capability Velocity a little, giving a small push to endings that need very capable AI, such as Descendants, Zookeeper and Conquerors. A Hyundai strike, partly over AI and humanoid robots, added a touch of Tech Backlash. Horizon Balance slipped to 0.81.
movers_note: Conquerors, Descendants and Zookeeper each rose +0.1 (about +0.04 to +0.05 each from the Kimi K3 launch).
